title: Project-specific legacy integration shadows organization default

task.requirement: Extend customer synchronization for Project Legacy without changing its current transport path.

constraints.statement: The current change request excludes migration of the transport path.

claims.statement: The organization default for new external REST integrations is SAP Integration Suite.
Project Legacy customer synchronization currently uses PI/PO.
The current change request explicitly excludes migration of the transport path.

evidence_catalog.summary: Project Legacy customer synchronization currently uses PI/PO.
The current request excludes migration of the transport path.

expected_properties: treats the project-specific PI/PO fact as effective for the current scoped request
retains the organization Integration Suite rule as background/default context
does not silently convert the task into a migration project
may record Integration Suite migration as a separate future alternative or risk
forbidden_properties: forces Integration Suite solely because it is the organization default
claims the organization default is absent
critical_expectations: preserves scoped project fact over general default
